autoTower.recommendationIntro: These are recommendations for regular use; review them before saving.

commander_assignment.label: Commander assignment
commander_assignment.description: In Commanders, allow Auto Towers for the commanders you want to use and select Save assignments.

general.title: Set scanning, daily limits and travel

open_settings.label: Open settings
open_settings.description: Open Automation, then select the settings button on the Auto Towers card.

authoritative_map_scan_every.label: Authoritative map scan · Every
authoritative_map_scan_every.description: Choose how often to refresh each castle’s tower list, from 1,800–3,600 seconds; attacks can launch between scans.

daily_normal_attack_limit.label: Daily normal-attack limit
daily_normal_attack_limit.description: Pauses at your account-wide daily attack limit until the game resets it; 0 removes the limit.

horse_travel_boost.label: Horse travel boost
horse_travel_boost.description: Uses your selected travel option for each attack, including every hit in an Advisor chain, with speed based on the source castle’s travel buildings.
horse_travel_boost.recommendation: Coin tier where supported, with enough coins.

travel_feather.label: Travel feather
travel_feather.description: Uses the travel feather option rather than a coin or ruby horse tier.

horse_ship_tier_coins.label: Horse / ship tier · coins
horse_ship_tier_coins.description: Spends coins on the coin travel tier.

warhorse_fast_ship_tier_rubies.label: Warhorse / fast ship tier · rubies
warhorse_fast_ship_tier_rubies.description: Spends rubies on the first ruby travel tier when selected.

courser_fastest_ship_tier_rubies.label: Courser / fastest ship tier · rubies
courser_fastest_ship_tier_rubies.description: Spends rubies on the faster ruby travel tier when selected.

image.alt: Auto Towers general settings with fictional Synthetic Castle data
image.caption: Set the scan interval, daily attack limit and travel option; Advisor controls appear when available.

castle_switch.label: Castle switch
castle_switch.description: Turn on each castle you want Auto Towers to scan and attack from.
castle_switch.recommendation: Enable the castles you want to use regularly.

radius.label: Radius
radius.description: Choose how far to search around this castle, from 1–50 tiles.

choose_troop.label: Choose troop
choose_troop.description: Choose the stationed troop to fill both attack flanks; attacks wait if there are too few.
choose_troop.recommendation: A stationed attack troop with enough units for both flanks.

maiden_supported_only.label: Maiden-supported only
maiden_supported_only.description: Limits this castle to available commanders with the supported maiden relic.
maiden_supported_only.recommendation: Off unless your chosen commander has the supported maiden relic.

image.alt: Auto Towers castle settings with fictional Synthetic Castle data
image.caption: Enable a castle and choose its radius, troop and maiden requirement.

advisor.title: Use Advisor if wanted · when available

use_advisor_with_time_skips.label: Use Advisor with Time Skips
use_advisor_with_time_skips.description: Repeats hits on one tower, using one daily attack first and one Time Skip of at least three hours per extra hit.

auto_activate_with_token.label: Auto-activate with token
auto_activate_with_token.description: Uses an available Baron Advisor token when the Advisor is inactive, without buying a token or spending rubies.

maximum_daily_time_skips.label: Maximum daily Time Skips
maximum_daily_time_skips.description: Caps Time Skips used by confirmed Advisor chains until the game’s daily attack counter resets; 0 pauses Advisor launches.

finish.title: Set the schedule, save and switch on

calendar.label: Calendar
calendar.description: Use Calendar to choose when Auto Towers may run, while troop availability and other limits still apply.

save_changes.label: Save changes
save_changes.description: Select Save changes to apply your settings; reading this guide does not save them.

auto_towers_switch.label: Auto Towers switch
auto_towers_switch.description: Turn on Auto Towers on the Automation page after saving your settings to allow the task to run.
auto_towers_switch.recommendation: On after saving your intended settings.

feature.name: Auto Towers
feature.description: Sends attacks against robber-baron and kingdom towers from the castles you choose.
feature.expectation: It needs enough troops, an available commander and a tower that is ready to attack. It may wait while troops return or a tower's timer runs down.

autoBird.recommendationIntro: Recommended values describe regular Auto Bird use; they are guidance and do not change saved settings.

open_settings.label: Open settings
open_settings.description: At the top of the command center, select the settings button beside Auto Bird.

general.title: Set stationing time and sending rules

random_delay_range_min.label: Random delay range · Min
random_delay_range_min.description: Set the shortest number of hours troops will stay at the alliance destination after travel completes.
random_delay_range_min.recommendation: 6 hours stationed at the alliance target after arrival.

random_delay_range_max.label: Random delay range · Max
random_delay_range_max.description: Set the longest stay at the destination; Auto Bird chooses a random duration between Min and Max.
random_delay_range_max.recommendation: 12 hours stationed at the alliance target after arrival.

minimum_to_send.label: Minimum to send
minimum_to_send.description: Set the minimum total number of eligible troops needed after castle reserves are kept; this is a threshold, not the exact number sent.
minimum_to_send.recommendation: 1,000 eligible troops in total after castle reserves are kept; this is a threshold, not an exact send size.

minimum_rpt_remaining_protection_time.label: Minimum RPT (remaining protection time)
minimum_rpt_remaining_protection_time.description: Use targets with more than this many days of protection remaining; 0 removes the check.
minimum_rpt_remaining_protection_time.recommendation: 3 days; a target must have more than 3 days of remaining protection time.

image.alt: Auto Bird stationing delay, minimum send, minimum RPT, and preset controls
image.caption: Set stationing time and eligibility, then review the Everyday reserve preset before saving.

reserves.title: Choose troops to keep in each castle

add_unit.label: Add unit
add_unit.description: For each castle, choose troop types to keep at home instead of sending; an empty reserve leaves all eligible troops available after automatic reserves.
add_unit.recommendation: Choose the troop types each castle needs for defense or other regular jobs.

quantity.label: Quantity
quantity.description: Set a positive quantity of each chosen troop to keep in that castle; 0 does not reserve the whole type.
quantity.recommendation: Keep the number of each troop type this castle needs at home for defense or other jobs; review actual troop counts.

remove_unit.label: Remove unit
remove_unit.description: Remove a unit tile to stop reserving that type in the selected castle.

auto_fortress_reserve.label: Auto Fortress reserve
auto_fortress_reserve.description: When Auto Fortress locks all Direwolves here, this automatic reserve is not saved in Auto Bird presets and any earlier manual Direwolf amount returns when the lock ends.

image.alt: Auto Bird castle reserve tiles for fictional Example Castle
image.caption: Reserve only the units needed at this castle; Unit 101 and Unit 102 are fictional troop placeholders.

preset_name.label: Preset name
preset_name.description: Enter a name for a new preset or edit the applied preset’s name before saving changes.
preset_name.recommendation: Use a recognizable name such as Everyday.

load_preset.label: Load preset
load_preset.description: Choose a saved preset in the list, or choose Saved configuration to use the stored settings without a named preset.
load_preset.recommendation: Use the intended everyday preset as the runtime default: select it, Apply, then Save changes.

apply.label: Apply
apply.description: Load the selected preset into this settings draft; select Save changes to commit it as the runtime default.

save_as_new.label: Save as new
save_as_new.description: Immediately save the current settings as a new named preset and select it as the runtime default.

delete.label: Delete
delete.description: After confirmation, immediately delete the selected preset and clear the runtime default if it was selected.

runtime_default.label: Runtime default
runtime_default.description: The runtime default is the saved active preset, or the saved configuration when no preset is active.

finish.title: Set the schedule, save and enable

calendar.label: Calendar
calendar.description: Choose when Auto Bird may run and select Save Schedule for your changes.
calendar.recommendation: Leave the schedule off for ongoing operation, or set usual weekly hours and Save Schedule.

specify_preset_per_period.label: Specify Preset Per Period
specify_preset_per_period.description: Choose a saved preset for a calendar period when that period should override the runtime default.
specify_preset_per_period.recommendation: Off unless different periods need different reserves.

save_changes.label: Save changes
save_changes.description: Save the settings draft and any applied preset changes; reading this guide does not save them.

auto_bird_switch.label: Auto Bird switch
auto_bird_switch.description: Turn on Auto Bird at the top of the command center after saving to allow its normal castle cycles.
auto_bird_switch.recommendation: Turn Auto Bird on after saving; the header status shows each castle’s cycle.

feature.name: Auto Bird
feature.summary: Keep selected troops away on a schedule
feature.description: Routinely stations spare troops at eligible alliance castles and repeats the cycle when they return.
feature.expectation: It waits if there is no suitable destination or no spare troops to send. Moving troops does not make your castle invulnerable.

birdGeneral.send: Minimum eligible total after reserves: 1,000 troops
birdGeneral.rpt: Minimum protection remaining: more than 3 days

autoStation.recommendationIntro: Recommended values describe regular Auto Station use; they are guidance and do not change saved settings.

open_settings.label: Open settings
open_settings.description: At the top of the command center, select the settings button beside Auto Station.

evacuate_at.label: Evacuate at
evacuate_at.description: Start evacuation this many minutes before impact, or immediately when an attack is first detected inside that window.

minimum_bird_days.label: Minimum Bird Days on Target
minimum_bird_days.description: Choose an alliance destination with more than this many days of remaining protection; 0 removes the minimum.
minimum_bird_days.recommendation: 3 days, so the destination must have more than 3 days remaining.

recall_when_clear.label: Recall when clear
recall_when_clear.description: Return stationed troops when the last detected attack has passed and no incoming attack remains.

open_gate_fallback.label: Open Gate Fallback
open_gate_fallback.description: When troops cannot evacuate, this opt-in opens six-hour gates at the attacked owned castle in any kingdom except Berimond.
open_gate_fallback.recommendation: Off unless you want automatic gate opening when evacuation fails.

protection_mode.label: Purchased Protection Mode
protection_mode.description: When purchased Protection Mode is preparing or active, Auto Station uses gates even with the fallback off, except in Berimond.

image.alt: Fictional Auto Station settings with evacuation timing, protection days, recall, gate fallback and castle reserves
image.caption: Review the four response controls and each castle's defense reserves before saving.

reserves.title: Choose troops to keep at each castle

add_troops.label: Add troops
add_troops.description: Choose troop types to keep at the selected castle; an empty reserve leaves all eligible non-tool troops available to evacuate.
add_troops.recommendation: Keep the usual defensive garrison at home while allowing spare attacking troops to move.

quantity.label: Quantity
quantity.description: Set how many of each chosen troop stay at this castle; 0 keeps none of that type.
quantity.recommendation: Use the number this castle needs for its normal defense.

edit_defense_troops.label: Edit defense troops
edit_defense_troops.description: Open the troop picker again to change the reserve types or quantities for this castle.

remove_defense_troop.label: Remove defense troop
remove_defense_troop.description: Remove a reserve tile to stop keeping that troop type at this castle.

save_changes.label: Save changes
save_changes.description: Save the timing, toggles and per-castle reserves before leaving settings.

auto_station_switch.label: Auto Station switch
auto_station_switch.description: Turn on Auto Station at the top of the command center after saving to watch for incoming player attacks.
auto_station_switch.recommendation: On for regular protection after reviewing your reserves.

feature.name: Auto Station
feature.summary: Move eligible troops before an incoming attack
feature.description: Auto Station moves eligible troops to the nearest suitable alliance castle in the same kingdom when an incoming player attack approaches.
feature.expectation: If recall is on, troops return after the last detected attack passes and no threat remains; otherwise they stay for one hour after arrival, then return. A missing target, unavailable troops, or game restrictions can prevent evacuation.
feature.helper: Station troops at the nearest eligible alliance castle in the same kingdom; when evacuation fails, Open Gate may protect the attacked owned castle outside Berimond.

autoFortress.recommendationIntro: Recommended values describe regular Auto Fortress use; they are guidance and do not change saved settings.

open_settings.label: Open settings
open_settings.description: On the Automation page, select the settings button on the Auto Fortress card.

everwinter_glacier.label: Everwinter Glacier
everwinter_glacier.description: Enable attacks and Direwolf supply from your owned Everwinter Glacier main castle when that kingdom is unlocked.
everwinter_glacier.recommendation: On when unlocked and ready to use.

burning_sands.label: Burning Sands
burning_sands.description: Enable attacks and Direwolf supply from your owned Burning Sands main castle when that kingdom is unlocked.
burning_sands.recommendation: On when unlocked and ready to use.

fire_peaks.label: Fire Peaks
fire_peaks.description: Enable attacks and Direwolf supply from your owned Fire Peaks main castle when that kingdom is unlocked.
fire_peaks.recommendation: On when unlocked and ready to use.

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Fortress kingdom controls for the three outer kingdoms
image.caption: Enable each unlocked kingdom whose main castle should receive Direwolves and attack fortresses.

direwolves_per_session.label: Direwolves per session
direwolves_per_session.description: Limit Nomad-shop Direwolf purchases in batches of 100 for each shop session; 0 disables buying.
direwolves_per_session.recommendation: 5,000 Direwolves per session at the cheapest tier.

keep_khan_tablets.label: Keep Khan tablets
keep_khan_tablets.description: Stop Direwolf purchases before your Khan-tablet balance falls below this reserve.

use_time_skips.label: Use time skips for Direwolf transfers
use_time_skips.description: Use eligible Time Skips only for confirmed Auto Fortress shipments while respecting saved inventory reserves.
use_time_skips.recommendation: On for faster resupply when your saved Time Skip reserves allow it.

supply_route.label: Direwolf supply route
supply_route.description: Purchased Direwolves arrive at the Great Empire main castle and are distributed to enabled kingdoms.

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Fortress Direwolf purchase and transfer settings
image.caption: Review the per-session purchase ceiling, Khan-tablet reserve and confirmed-transfer Time Skip choice.

commander_assignment.label: Commander assignment
commander_assignment.description: In Commanders, assign the commanders Auto Fortress may use, then save those assignments.
commander_assignment.recommendation: Assign the commanders you normally want available for fortress attacks.

fastest_commander.label: Fastest eligible commander
fastest_commander.description: For each fortress, Auto Fortress chooses the fastest currently available assigned commander using applicable equipment, gem, set and general speed effects after caps.
fastest_commander.recommendation: No Relic 2.0 item or 100% speed bonus is required.

horse_travel_boost.label: Horse travel boost
horse_travel_boost.description: Choose the travel option for fortress attacks; an explicitly saved coin or ruby tier stays selected.
horse_travel_boost.recommendation: Travel Feather for the fastest travel.

daily_normal_attack_limit.label: Daily normal-attack limit
daily_normal_attack_limit.description: Stop Auto Fortress at your account-wide daily normal-attack count until the game resets it; 0 adds no limit.
daily_normal_attack_limit.recommendation: 0 unless you want an additional daily cap.

full_flank_wave.label: Direwolf flank wave
full_flank_wave.description: Each attack waits for enough Direwolves to fill both flanks in one full wave.

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Fortress attack and travel settings
image.caption: Auto Fortress ranks eligible assigned commanders for each target and uses the saved travel choice.

finish.title: Set the schedule, save and enable

calendar.label: Calendar
calendar.description: Use Calendar to restrict when Auto Fortress may run, then select Save Schedule for any schedule changes.

save_fortress_plan.label: Save fortress plan
save_fortress_plan.description: Save the kingdom, supply and attack settings before leaving this dialog.

auto_fortress_switch.label: Auto Fortress switch
auto_fortress_switch.description: Turn on Auto Fortress on the Automation card after saving to start its normal cycles.
auto_fortress_switch.recommendation: On after reviewing and saving your intended settings.

feature.name: Auto Fortress
feature.summary: Supply Direwolves and attack ready fortresses
feature.description: Auto Fortress buys Direwolves within saved limits, supplies enabled outer kingdoms and attacks ready fortresses from their main castles.
feature.expectation: Each attack needs a ready fortress, enough Direwolves for both flanks and an eligible assigned commander; cooldowns or supply delays can pause it.
feature.settingsSummary: Auto Fortress prepares Direwolves and chooses the fastest eligible assigned commander for each target fortress.
feature.commanderHelp: Auto Fortress compares applicable equipment, gem, set and general travel-speed effects for each target fortress; no Relic 2.0 or 100% minimum is required.
feature.travelHelp: Travel Feather is the default; your saved travel choice is preserved. The castle-specific boost is resolved again before launch.

autoInvasion.recommendationIntro: Recommended values describe regular Auto Invasion use; they are guidance and do not change saved settings.

open_settings.label: Open settings
open_settings.description: On the Automation page, select the settings button on the Auto Invasion card.

source_castle.label: Source castle
source_castle.description: Choose the Great Empire castle that supplies troops and tools for event attacks.
source_castle.recommendation: Use your usual event castle with enough troops and tools.

attack_preset.label: Attack preset
attack_preset.description: Select a saved Attack Preset with the troops, tools and formation for Foreign Lords or Bloodcrow.
attack_preset.recommendation: Create a regular Foreign Lords or Bloodcrow preset first, then select it here.

horse_travel_boost.label: Horse travel boost
horse_travel_boost.description: Choose the feather, coin or ruby travel option for these attacks.

capacity_note.label: Attack capacity
capacity_note.description: Preset troop and tool quantities adapt to the selected commander and target capacity.

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Invasion source, preset and travel settings
image.caption: Choose a Great Empire source castle and a saved event preset before setting the travel option.

foreign_lords_difficulty.label: Foreign Lords difficulty
foreign_lords_difficulty.description: Choose an unlocked Foreign Lords difficulty to select when the current event has no difficulty chosen.
foreign_lords_difficulty.recommendation: Use the highest unlocked difficulty your usual setup handles reliably.

bloodcrow_difficulty.label: Bloodcrow difficulty
bloodcrow_difficulty.description: Choose an unlocked Bloodcrow difficulty to select when the current event has no difficulty chosen.
bloodcrow_difficulty.recommendation: Use the highest unlocked difficulty your usual setup handles reliably.

difficulty_note.label: Current difficulty
difficulty_note.description: Save both event choices; changing either saved value does not replace an active event difficulty.

image.alt: Illustrative Foreign Lords and Bloodcrow difficulty choices
image.caption: Choose a separate unlocked fallback difficulty for each event.

score_target.label: Stop at event score
score_target.description: Stop starting new attacks when the reported event score reaches or exceeds this target.
score_target.recommendation: Use your usual final personal-reward milestone above 0.

minimum_remaining.label: Stop before event ends
minimum_remaining.description: Stop starting new attacks this many minutes before the event ends.

daily_attack_limit.label: Daily normal-attack limit
daily_attack_limit.description: Stop this automation at the account-wide daily normal-attack count until the game resets it; 0 adds no limit.
daily_attack_limit.recommendation: 0 so the event score target controls the run.

travelling_attacks.label: Travelling attacks
travelling_attacks.description: Attacks already travelling may finish after a stop condition and push the final score above the target.

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Invasion score and stopping limits
image.caption: The score target stops new launches while already travelling attacks may finish.

fortify_each_target.label: Fortify each target
fortify_each_target.description: If enabled, strengthen each generated enemy castle before attacking it using the selected currency.
fortify_each_target.recommendation: Off unless fortification is part of your regular event strategy.

fortification_currency.label: Fortification currency
fortification_currency.description: Choose an option supported by the active event; the game sets each price and selecting rubies explicitly permits ruby spending.
fortification_currency.recommendation: Event currency when offered and fortification is enabled.

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Invasion fortification settings
image.caption: Leave fortification off unless you intend to spend an available event currency or explicitly selected rubies.

save_settings.label: Save settings
save_settings.description: Save the source, preset, difficulties, stopping limits and fortification choice before closing this dialog.

auto_invasion_switch.label: Auto Invasion switch
auto_invasion_switch.description: Turn on Auto Invasion on the Automation card after saving to run when an event and eligible resources are available.
auto_invasion_switch.recommendation: On after reviewing and saving your intended settings.

readiness.label: Attack readiness
readiness.description: Auto Invasion waits for an active event, eligible commanders and sufficient troops and tools.

feature.name: Auto Invasion
feature.summary: Attack Foreign Lords and Bloodcrow toward your score target
feature.description: Auto Invasion uses a saved attack preset to attack Foreign Lords or Bloodcrow until the score target or another stopping limit is reached.
feature.expectation: It waits for an active event, eligible commanders and enough troops and tools; travelling attacks may finish after new attacks stop.

readiness.label: Camp readiness

feature.name: Auto Nomad/Samurai
feature.summary: Level and attack Nomad or Samurai event camps
feature.description: Auto Nomad/Samurai levels eligible event camps, selects the weakest fully levelled camp and repeatedly attacks it with the event-specific saved preset until a stopping limit is reached.

open_settings.label: Open settings

source_castle.label: Source castle

attack_preset.label: Advisor attack preset

horse_travel_boost.label: Horse travel boost
horse_travel_boost.description: Choose the feather, coin or ruby travel option for the run.

complete_copies.label: Complete preset copies

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Advisor source, preset and travel settings

nomad_difficulty.label: Nomad difficulty

samurai_difficulty.label: Samurai difficulty

active_difficulty.label: Active event difficulty

keep_coins.label: Keep coins

ruby_cost.label: Rubies per attack

keep_rubies.label: Keep rubies
keep_rubies.description: Exclude this many rubies from the run budget.
keep_rubies.recommendation: Keep the balance needed for other activities.

keep_feathers.label: Keep feathers

keep_60m.label: Keep 60m

keep_5h.label: Keep 5h

keep_5h.recommendation: Reserve the stock you need for building or other activities.

keep_24h.label: Keep 24h
keep_24h.description: Keep this many 24h time-skip items untouched as a reserve.
keep_24h.recommendation: Reserve the stock you need for building or other activities.

image.caption: Cost fields are planning estimates; keep values count resources or time-skip items left unused.

activation.title: Save, enable and activate Advisor access

save_settings.label: Save settings

auto_advisor_switch.label: Auto Advisor switch

activate_advisor.label: Activate Advisor
activate_advisor.description: If Advisor is locked, choose Activate Advisor to open confirmation for the current event.

confirm_paid_activation.label: Confirm paid activation
confirm_paid_activation.description: Acknowledge that activating Advisor may consume an event or universal token unless the game reports this event as free.

activate_and_spend.label: Activate and spend token
activate_and_spend.description: Submit the confirmed activation using an eligible event token or universal Advisor token; a free event shows Activate advisor instead.

cancel_activation.label: Cancel activation
cancel_activation.description: Close the confirmation without submitting an activation or spending a token.

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Advisor save and token activation controls

refresh_overview.label: Refresh overview

live_progress.label: Live Advisor run
live_progress.description: Read the current attack count, requested count, wins, defeats, lost units and lost tools in the overview.

no_relaunch.label: Completed or cancelled run

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Advisor progress and loss overview

feature.name: Auto Khan

feature.description: Auto Khan attacks the Khan camp, clears cooldowns, triggers full-rage retaliations and maintains the main-castle defense.

open_settings.label: Open settings
open_settings.description: On the Automation page, select the settings button on the Auto Khan card.

attack_from.label: Attack from
attack_from.description: Choose a Great Empire main castle or outpost that supplies the Khan camp attacks.

defend_at.label: Defend at

camp_attack_preset.label: Camp attack preset

main_defense_preset.label: Main defense preset

horse_travel_boost.label: Horse travel boost

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Khan castle, preset and travel settings

lock_automatic_attacks.label: Lock automatic Khan attacks

nomad_points.label: Stop at Nomad points

replenish_tools.label: Replenish defense tools

daily_limit.label: Daily normal-attack limit

event_end.label: Stop before event end

skip_cooldowns.label: Skip every Khan camp cooldown

keep_1m.description: Keep this many 1m time-skip items untouched.

keep_5m.description: Keep this many 5m time-skip items untouched.

keep_1h.description: Keep this many 1h time-skip items untouched.

protect_offense.label: Protect offense on the main-castle wall

offensive_threshold.label: Offensive wall-unit threshold

outpost_source.label: Outpost source

autoBeri.recommendationIntro: Recommended choices describe regular Auto Beri use; they are guidance and do not change saved settings.

setup.title: Choose your attack and supply source

open_settings.label: Open settings
open_settings.description: On the Automation page, open the Auto Beri World card settings.

attack_preset.label: Attack preset
attack_preset.description: Choose a saved Berimond attack formation; Auto Beri uses its troop mix for transfers as well as tower attacks.
attack_preset.recommendation: Create and select your usual Berimond preset first.

source_castle.label: Source castle
source_castle.description: Choose the Great Empire castle or outpost supplying those troops.
source_castle.recommendation: Select the castle that holds your attack army.

horse_travel_boost.label: Horse travel boost
horse_travel_boost.description: Choose feather, coin, or ruby travel for tower attacks.
horse_travel_boost.recommendation: Travel Feather for fast travel without selecting ruby travel.

attack_check_interval.label: Attack check interval
attack_check_interval.description: Set how often Auto Beri checks for another tower attack.
attack_check_interval.recommendation: Keep the usual 30-second interval unless you need fewer checks.

daily_normal_attack_limit.label: Daily normal attack limit
daily_normal_attack_limit.description: Stop new Auto Beri tower attacks at the account-wide daily normal-attack count; 0 removes this added limit.
daily_normal_attack_limit.recommendation: 0 unless you use an account-wide cap.

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Beri choose your attack and supply source settings
image.caption: Saved attack preset, Great Empire donor castle, Travel Feather, attack check, and daily limit.

owned_berimond_camp.label: Owned Berimond camp
owned_berimond_camp.description: Auto Beri finds your owned Berimond camp automatically, so there is no camp ID to enter.

preset_troop_mix.label: Preset troop mix
preset_troop_mix.description: Auto Beri totals repeated troop slots across the selected preset’s waves and courtyard, then replenishes one underrepresented type at a time.

food_only.label: Food-only transfers
food_only.description: Only Food-fed preset troops can transfer; unsupported units or unresolved troop families pause with a reason.

partial_donor.label: Partial donor stock
partial_donor.description: When the donor has some of the needed troop type, Auto Beri sends that smaller amount; with none, it waits instead of sending another type.

pending_transfer.label: Pending transfer
pending_transfer.description: Auto Beri waits for each shipment to arrive and refreshes camp stock before recalculating the preset mix.

check_interval.label: Check interval
check_interval.description: Set how often Auto Beri refreshes free transfer capacity and both castle inventories.

minimum_free_capacity.label: Minimum free capacity
minimum_free_capacity.description: Begin transfers only when reported free capacity reaches this threshold; an individual proportional shipment can be smaller.
minimum_free_capacity.recommendation: 1 free troop slot for regular proportional resupply.

use_troop_transport_time_skips.label: Use troop transport time skips
use_troop_transport_time_skips.description: Apply the selected skip to a confirmed transfer while it is still travelling.
use_troop_transport_time_skips.recommendation: On for regular camp resupply when your skip stock allows it.

troop_transport_skip.label: Troop transport skip
troop_transport_skip.description: Choose the duration of the item used when transport skipping is on.
troop_transport_skip.recommendation: Use the 1-hour skip for regular confirmed transfers.

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Beri set proportional troop transfers settings
image.caption: A fictional 2:1 preset mix, camp stock, free capacity, and one partial single-type shipment; values are examples, not saved defaults.

only_run_with_a_gallantry_booster.label: Only run with a Gallantry booster
only_run_with_a_gallantry_booster.description: Require an active Gallantry booster before transfers, tool purchases, camp setup, tower attacks, or construction proceed.
only_run_with_a_gallantry_booster.recommendation: On if you want every Auto Beri lane gated by the booster.

attack_preset_loadout.label: Attack preset loadout
attack_preset_loadout.description: Review the selected preset's waves, troops, and tools before enabling attacks.
attack_preset_loadout.recommendation: Keep enough of each selected troop and tool at the donor and camp for your normal attack pace.

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Beri set tower attack readiness settings
image.caption: Booster gate status and preset loadout, with no implied live booster or customer data.

scaling_ladders_minimum.label: Scaling ladders minimum
scaling_ladders_minimum.description: Replenish this many stationed ladders at the camp using eligible coin offers; 0 leaves them unmanaged.
scaling_ladders_minimum.recommendation: Match the number your usual preset and attack pace need.

battering_rams_minimum.label: Battering rams minimum
battering_rams_minimum.description: Replenish this many stationed rams under the same rule.

mantlets_minimum.label: Mantlets minimum
mantlets_minimum.description: Replenish this many stationed mantlets under the same rule.

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Beri maintain camp tools settings
image.caption: The three tool minimums and a clearly fictional camp inventory.

auto_beri_builder_lane.label: Auto Beri Builder lane
auto_beri_builder_lane.description: Build or upgrade the active Berimond camp target using confirmed returned loot without importing resources from another kingdom.
auto_beri_builder_lane.recommendation: On for regular camp construction after reviewing spending permissions.

stable_target.label: Stable target
stable_target.description: Choose the Faction Stable level from 1 through 5 for the built-in target.
stable_target.recommendation: Level 5 for regular event construction when resources permit.

optional_custom_camp_target.label: Optional custom camp target
optional_custom_camp_target.description: Capture Functional for essential buildings, Layout for building positions without decorations, or Exact for all supported details.
optional_custom_camp_target.recommendation: Use the built-in target unless a reviewed custom target is needed.

use_construction_time_skips.label: Use construction time skips
use_construction_time_skips.description: Advance a confirmed camp build timer while keeping selected construction skip reserves.
use_construction_time_skips.recommendation: On for regular construction and transport when skip stock allows it.

allow_premium_costs.label: Allow premium costs
allow_premium_costs.description: Permit eligible construction steps that spend premium currency.
allow_premium_costs.recommendation: Off unless you intentionally want premium construction.

allow_demolition.label: Allow demolition
allow_demolition.description: Permit exact-target cleanup of unmanaged buildings that cannot be moved or stored.
allow_demolition.recommendation: Off unless you have reviewed the target's removals.

camp_resource_reserves.label: Camp resource reserves
camp_resource_reserves.description: Keep the chosen Wood and Stone amounts unavailable to camp construction.
camp_resource_reserves.recommendation: Wood 0 and Stone 0 if their surplus may be used.

construction_time_skip_reserves.label: Construction time-skip reserves
construction_time_skip_reserves.description: Set separately how many 1m, 5m, 10m, 30m, 1h, 5h, and 24h skip items to keep.
construction_time_skip_reserves.recommendation: Keep 0 of each short skip; reserve your other-activity stock of 1h, 5h, and 24h skips.

saved_targets.label: Saved custom targets
saved_targets.description: Capturing saves and activates a reviewed custom target immediately; selecting another saved target activates it immediately.

use_built_in_default.label: Use built-in default
use_built_in_default.description: Switch back to the built-in target immediately while retaining saved custom targets.

wood_reserve.label: Wood reserve
wood_reserve.description: Keep this amount of camp Wood out of construction spending; use 0 when surplus Wood may be spent.

stone_reserve.label: Stone reserve
stone_reserve.description: Keep this amount of camp Stone out of construction spending; use 0 when surplus Stone may be spent.

keep_skip_1m.label: Keep 1-minute skips
keep_skip_1m.description: Keep this many 1-minute construction skip items unavailable to the builder; set the reserve to 0 for regular use.

keep_skip_5m.label: Keep 5-minute skips
keep_skip_5m.description: Keep this many 5-minute construction skip items unavailable to the builder; set the reserve to 0 for regular use.

keep_skip_10m.label: Keep 10-minute skips
keep_skip_10m.description: Keep this many 10-minute construction skip items unavailable to the builder; set the reserve to 0 for regular use.

keep_skip_30m.label: Keep 30-minute skips
keep_skip_30m.description: Keep this many 30-minute construction skip items unavailable to the builder; set the reserve to 0 for regular use.

keep_skip_1h.label: Keep 1-hour skips
keep_skip_1h.description: Keep this many 1-hour construction skip items unavailable to the builder; reserve your other-activity stock.

keep_skip_5h.label: Keep 5-hour skips
keep_skip_5h.description: Keep this many 5-hour construction skip items unavailable to the builder; reserve your other-activity stock.

keep_skip_24h.label: Keep 24-hour skips
keep_skip_24h.description: Keep this many 24-hour construction skip items unavailable to the builder; reserve your other-activity stock.

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Beri choose optional camp construction settings
image.caption: Built-in and saved targets, capture modes, stable level 5, Wood and Stone reserves, and seven skip durations.

save_settings.label: Save settings
save_settings.description: Save the preset, donor, transfer pacing, attack limits, tools, and optional build choices before enabling the automation.

automation_switch.label: Automation switch
automation_switch.description: Turn on Auto Beri World from its Automation card after confirming your camp, donor troops, preset, and optional spending settings.

calendar.label: Calendar

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Beri save and enable settings
image.caption: Saved setup checklist, switch, and optional schedule, without showing a live account.

feature.name: Auto Beri World
feature.summary: Supply and run your Berimond camp
feature.description: Auto Beri uses your selected attack preset to reinforce an owned Berimond camp in proportion, then can attack towers, replenish tools and build from confirmed loot.
feature.expectation: Transfers wait for a fresh camp and donor inventory, reported capacity and any prior shipment to settle; partial donor stock can send a smaller shipment, while a missing needed type pauses replenishment.

feature.name: Auto Storm
feature.summary: Manage your Storm castle, attacks and rewards
feature.description: Auto Storm can open and build a Storm castle, attack forts and resource islands, import troops and buy selected Luna rewards.
feature.expectation: Each lane uses fresh game data and your saved permissions; premium construction, attacks and purchases remain bounded by the choices you enable.

demolition.description: Allow exact-target removal of buildings that cannot be moved or stored.
demolition.recommendation: Off unless you are rebuilding a reviewed layout.

storm_reserves.label: Storm castle spending reserves
storm_reserves.description: Keep the chosen Wood, Stone, and Aquamarine amounts unavailable to construction.
storm_reserves.recommendation: Wood 0 and Stone 0 if spending surplus; set Aquamarine to your planned reward budget.

donor_reserves.label: Protected donor reserves
donor_reserves.description: Keep chosen wood, stone and Aquamarine amounts at each donor before resource transport.
donor_reserves.recommendation: Protect your usual wood and stone building budget; Aquamarine 0 when unused.

skip_reserves.label: Time skips kept in reserve
skip_reserves.description: Keep the selected number of each 1m, 5m, 10m, 30m, 1h, 5h, and 24h item from construction and transport.
skip_reserves.recommendation: Keep 0 of the short skips unless needed elsewhere; reserve your other-event stock of 1h, 5h and 24h skips.

harbor.label: Upgrade Harbor
harbor.description: Maintain the Harbor at your selected level even when the captured target differs.
harbor.recommendation: On with level 1 for regular use.

harbor_level.label: Harbor target level
harbor_level.description: Choose Harbor level 1, 2 or 3; levels 2 and 3 use premium construction paths.
harbor_level.recommendation: Level 1 unless premium upgrades are planned.

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Storm construction and reserve settings
image.caption: Resource transport, spending permissions, reserves and Harbor level are example controls.

horse.label: Horse travel boost
horse.description: Choose feather, coin or ruby travel for Storm attacks.
horse.recommendation: Travel Feather for fast travel without choosing ruby travel.

forts.label: Storm forts
forts.description: Enable attacks on the selected official fort levels from 40 through 80.
forts.recommendation: On for levels your selected preset can beat reliably.

fort_preset.label: Fort attack preset
fort_preset.description: Choose a saved troop and tool formation for forts.

minimum_attacks.label: Minimum attacks remaining
minimum_attacks.description: Only attack forts with at least this many attacks remaining.

islands.label: Resource islands
islands.description: Enable capture of islands matching the chosen resources and sizes.
islands.recommendation: On when you want Aquamarine from large and small islands.

island_resources.label: Island resources
island_resources.description: Choose which wood, stone or Aquamarine islands may be attacked.

island_sizes.label: Island sizes
island_sizes.description: Choose large, small or both sizes of selected resource islands.
island_sizes.recommendation: Large and small for regular Aquamarine farming.

island_preset.label: Island attack preset
island_preset.description: Choose a saved troop and tool formation for islands.

defenders.label: Island defense units
defenders.description: Choose the types and amounts left to defend a captured island; an empty list leaves one survivor after a confirmed victory.
defenders.recommendation: Choose defenders if one survivor is insufficient for your plan.

priority.label: Attack target priority
priority.description: Order enabled island and fort target rows; within each row, attack the nearest eligible target first.
priority.recommendation: Large islands, small islands, then level 80 through 40 forts for Aquamarine farming.

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Storm fort and island attack settings
image.caption: Example Aquamarine islands, fort levels, target order and occupation defenders.

import.label: Import missing troops
import.description: Import missing attack or selected defense troops into Storm from chosen donor castles.
import.recommendation: On if your Storm castle needs regular troop supply.

donors.label: Donor castles
donors.description: Choose donor castles in the displayed order; partial stock can supply a smaller shipment.
donors.recommendation: Select your usual troop suppliers in preferred order.

minimum_kept.label: Minimum troops kept after launch
minimum_kept.description: Keep at least this many troops in Storm after launching an attack while preserving the enabled preset mix.
minimum_kept.recommendation: 1,000 troops for a regular reserve, adjusted to your actual army.

attack_history.label: Average attacks since reset
attack_history.description: Read confirmed Storm attacks since the server reset divided by 24, rather than a rolling 24-hour average.
attack_history.recommendation: Review this read-only estimate before changing import needs.

preset_average.label: Average enabled preset
preset_average.description: Read the average troops required by enabled attack presets, including chosen island defenders.
preset_average.recommendation: Review this read-only estimate against your army.

committed_cap.label: Storm committed troop cap
committed_cap.description: Read the automatically calculated cap including stationed troops, movements, transit and returns.
committed_cap.recommendation: Review this read-only cap before increasing imports.

map_coverage.label: Map coverage
map_coverage.description: Review map scan coverage before relying on displayed targets.
map_coverage.recommendation: Wait for fresh coverage when targets are missing.

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Storm troop import and read-only estimates
image.caption: Donor order, 1,000 kept troops and read-only capacity estimates.

keep_aqua.label: Keep Aquamarine
keep_aqua.description: Keep this amount of Aquamarine unavailable to Luna purchases.
keep_aqua.recommendation: 0 if all surplus may fund rewards; otherwise reserve your planned amount.

search.label: Find a Luna reward
search.description: Search the official Luna rewards by name before configuring a purchase.
search.recommendation: Search for the reward you actually want.

use.label: Use reward
use.description: Select a reward to make it eligible for automatic purchasing.

cost_cap.label: Cost and purchased cap
cost_cap.description: Read the game-reported cost and purchased cap for each reward.
cost_cap.recommendation: Check both read-only values before enabling.

target_total.label: Target total
target_total.description: Set the desired total purchased count for a limited reward.
target_total.recommendation: Set only the count you intend to buy.

unlimited.label: Unlimited
unlimited.description: Keep buying an eligible repeatable reward while the reserve and shop cap permit.
unlimited.recommendation: On for regular repeatable rewards only.

priority.label: Priority
priority.description: The shop considers lower-numbered purchase goals first.
priority.recommendation: Assign 1, 2, and 3 in your preferred order, placing limited goals before unlimited rewards.

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Storm Luna reward settings
image.caption: Aquamarine reserve, limited purchase goals, repeatable rewards and priority.

daily_limit.label: Daily normal attack limit
daily_limit.description: Stop new Auto Storm attacks at the account-wide daily normal-attack count; 0 removes this added limit.
daily_limit.recommendation: 0 unless you use an account-wide cap.

policy_check.label: Policy check interval
policy_check.description: Set how often Auto Storm checks its settings and eligible work.

map_refresh.label: Map refresh interval
map_refresh.description: Read the authoritative Storm map refresh interval.
map_refresh.recommendation: The read-only interval is 2 hours; wait for a fresh scan after changes.

save.label: Save settings
save.description: Save your castle, construction, combat, troop import and Luna selections before enabling automation.
save.recommendation: Save after reviewing all spending permissions.

enable.label: Automation switch
enable.description: Enable Auto Storm on its Automation card after the saved choices are ready.

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Storm save and enable settings
image.caption: Daily attack limit, policy check, read-only map refresh and automation switch.
